title: Correct Intention copy and textarea readability
objective: Validate and correct the Day Setup Intention field copy and textarea readability: the prompt names one focus for today, every state (text, placeholder, surface, border, focus, disabled) is readable and intentionally styled, the capture never clips at desktop or narrow widths, persistence is unchanged, and user-facing times stay 12-hour.

treatment.copy: Label 'Intention' plus helper 'One thing to focus on today.' (exact FEEDBACK-13 sentence, unchanged). Empty state gains placeholder 'One thing to focus on today' so the field reads as a single focus before typing.
readable_states: focus: :focus-visible outline 2px solid var(--t-accent), outline-offset 1px, border-color var(--t-accent)
disabled: color var(--t-muted), background var(--t-surface-2), border-color var(--t-border), cursor not-allowed
treatment.narrow_width: @media (max-width: 520px) { .field textarea.cap-intention { flex-basis: 100% } } so the 96px label keeps its own row and the textarea takes a full field line — no clipping.
treatment.unchanged: DaySetup data shape, captures.intention persistence, and SETUP_SAVED flow untouched.

measurable.placeholder_equals: One thing to focus on today
measurable.helper: p#cap-intention-hint.field__hint text_equals 'One thing to focus on today.'
